paragraph: A man in Washington Heights started sweeping his block in New York City every day. He kept at it for one hundred days. Neighbors saw him with his broom and began to join in. The street had been dirty. Together they made it clean. There is a plant called the lotus that grows well in murky water. Out of that dirt came something people wanted to tend together.

seed.summary: In New York City, something magical has happened along the sidewalk in Washington Heights that can best be described in a metaphor.
